inputs.text:
Folks, once again we see the radical left trembling at the mere thought of accountability and the rule of law. White House border czar Tom Homan made it entirely clear on Tuesday during an appearance on “The Charlie Kirk Show” when he rightly refused to rule out the presence of immigration enforcement at polling places, demanding to know what Democrats are “afraid of.” 

Of course, the mainstream narrative is whining about inconsistent answers from the Trump administration, but let’s look at what really matters here: basic national sovereignty, secure borders, and the fundamental integrity of our electoral process. If you have nothing to hide and you are here lawfully, why would you fear the presence of lawful authorities ensuring that our sacred civic duties are protected from subversion? This is about standing up for tradition, enforcing our laws, and preserving the nation for our citizens. The Democrats and their progressive allies only care about eroding our borders and our standards, but true leadership means putting the security and order of the American family first.
